content: Spring Boot 3.x line requires Java 17 minimum. Spring Boot 3.5 is the last 3.x minor (six minors 3.0-3.5); Spring Boot 4.0.0 released Nov 20, 2025, moving to Spring Framework 7, Jackson 3, Jakarta EE 11 with breaking changes. For 2026 new projects, Spring official migration guide recommends landing on 3.5 before considering 4.0. No Spring Boot release is formally 'LTS' -- each gets ~12 months OSS support; Java 17 and 21 are the LTS JDKs commonly paired with Boot 3.x.
